primary_automatic_evaluation.ground_truth: RSAT dissatisfaction_reason mapped to six canonical aspects

transformer_evaluation.split: The same group-deduplicated 2025 split used by the rule and TF-IDF models

duplicate_control.policy: Each normalized description belongs only to its earliest observed year; only labels observed in that first year are eligible, then one row per description-aspect pair is retained.

transfer_boundary: 311 resolution narratives are evaluated as a transfer target, not as unrestricted citizen commentary.
manual_annotation_status: Future work; no synthetic human labels are used.
